card.name: She/her for ships and countries
card.fires_on: The pronouns she, her and herself used for a ship (Titanic, Tirpitz, Edmund Fitzgerald) or a nation (Canada, Belgium, the Confederacy). It fires where the pronoun refers back to that vessel or country.

modes.label: Ships as she
modes.description: Feminine pronoun standing for a ship or wreck in a history or shipwreck narrative.

modes.label: Countries as her
modes.description: Feminine pronoun standing for a country or nation in political writing.

card.plain: It marks the pronoun she or her when it refers to a ship or a country instead of a woman.
